=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:120-131 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `captured_at` chain (`date -u -d "${captured_at}" +%s%3N`, the `%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ` round-trip and the `if [ "${roundtrip}" != "${captured_at}" ]` compare) rejects fresh, well-formed timestamps with `reason=captured_at`. CI run 43255940833 shows this in test_valid_record_is_stored_at_the_expected_path and test_consumer_repo_is_allowed.
  WHY: Valid records are rejected before the Contents API write. In route mode the dispatch has already returned 204 and Telegram was skipped, so a WARNING/ERROR alert is neither stored nor delivered, and CI stays red. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER; confidence ranged from 4 to 5.
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:167-172, 244-253 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If a concurrent intake creates `ai/alert-inbox` after this run's failed PUT, `_alert_inbox_ensure_branch` gets HTTP 200 and returns 0 without setting `BRANCH_CREATED=1`. The `404|422` arm then calls `_alert_inbox_fail "http_${put_code}"` instead of retrying the PUT.
  WHY: Intake runs use per-run concurrency groups (`alert-inbox-intake-${{ github.run_id }}`), so they run in parallel and a burst can drop records, including route-mode alerts already withheld from Telegram. All rated MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 (sonnet) to 4.
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:93-96 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The jq level check `[$r.level] | inside(["WARNING","ERROR","CRITICAL"])` matches by substring, so `""`, `"ERR"`, `"WARN"`, `"CRIT"` and `"R"` pass validation.
  WHY: Invalid-level records are written to `ai/alert-inbox` as valid `alert_inbox.v1` records, which breaks the "every field is validated" contract. The REJECTIONS test only covers `"DEBUG"` and `3`.
- agents.md:5611-5618 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The generated `<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block omits `.github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml`, so `make generate-check` reports "FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate".
  WHY: static-checks fails on every run, which fails the lint aggregate job, blocks the merge and skips the later static checks. The fix is to run `make generate`, not to hand-edit the file.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:48-124 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The Workflows and Scripts sections have no entries for `.github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml`, `scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh` or `scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh`.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails the tests-release-and-log-analysis job with 9 FAIL lines: the 3 missing entries plus cross-references at README.md:2512/2523 and agents.md:2021. Later steps in that job are skipped.
- .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml:58-73 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Notify store failure" step (`if: failure()`) runs `source scripts/tg_helpers.sh`. If the checkout step failed, that file does not exist and `source` aborts under `set -euo pipefail` before any notice is sent.
  WHY: A checkout failure drops the record with no Telegram notice, which contradicts the header comment "A failed store sends one Telegram notice". All rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "New `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json` with: `capture_enabled: false` and `route_warning_error_to_inbox: false`; `pipeline_self_files` (list from plan section 'Triage'); `break_glass_allowed_paths` and `break_glass_denied_paths` (lists from plan section 'Self-fix and break-glass')."
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json (new file, 2-space JSON; content from docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md lines 309-315 and 371-376)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The file is absent from pr_changed_files.txt and from the working tree. tests/test_tg_helpers_alert_inbox.py:409 (test_shipped_config_is_off) fails in CI run 43255940833 with FileNotFoundError. Without the file, the production path `tg_send_msg → alert_inbox_mode → alert_inbox_capture` falls back to `off`, so the feature is dead in this repo. The plan lists 15 `pipeline_self_files` entries, 6 `break_glass_allowed_paths` globs and 7 `break_glass_denied_paths` entries.
- requirement: The new workflow and scripts must be registered in `docs/INVENTORY.md` (Workflows and Scripts sections) so `tests/inventory_parity.py` passes.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md (Workflows: .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml; Scripts: scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh, scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk touches docs/INVENTORY.md and a grep finds no alert_inbox entries. CI run 43255940833 (tests-release-and-log-analysis) names all three missing entries plus the undocumented references at README.md:2512/2523 and agents.md:2021.
- requirement: The auto-generated repo tree in `agents.md` must include the new workflow so `make generate-check` passes (`make generate` owns the tree).
  expected_change_site: agents.md `<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block (lines 5611-5613), regenerated via `make generate`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

- requirement: The staging loops for the trusted support checkout must include `scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh` beside `tg_helpers.sh`, so capture is reachable on consumer repos without consumer edits.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml and .github/workflows/plan.yml staging lists (minimax also names implement.yml and review_autofix.yml)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The staging loops at `clarify.yml:493` and `plan.yml:606` include `tg_helpers.sh` but omit `alert_inbox_capture.sh`. `tg_helpers.sh:34-38` skips capture when the companion script is absent, and `agents.d/alert-triage-phase1-inbox-capture.md` says "staged runs stay off until a later phase stages it". Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this as a deliberate phase-1 deferral. They cite the issue text ("If it is missing ... treat capture as failed or off") and note these workflow files are outside the plan grant's files_touched.
- requirement: Done criteria "With capture on in a test, one record lands on the branch" and "tests/test_alert_inbox_store.py: validation, path format, 409 retry, branch bootstrap" must pass in CI.
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh (captured_at chain, lines 120-131) and tests/test_alert_inbox_store.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: In CI run 43255940833, tests-heal-plan-and-validation has 3 failures: test_shipped_config_is_off, test_valid_record_is_stored_at_the_expected_path and test_consumer_repo_is_allowed (reason=captured_at). === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:jq level check `elif ([$r.level] | inside(["WARNING","ERROR","CRITICAL"]) | not) or ($r.level | type) != "string" then "level"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: jq `inside` matches strings by substring, so `""`, `"ERR"`, `"WARN"`, `"CRIT"`, `"R"` and `"ARN"` pass.
  WHY: Invalid records are stored on `ai/alert-inbox` as valid `alert_inbox.v1` and later read as trusted. REJECTIONS only tries `"DEBUG"` and `3`. Fix: `IN("WARNING","ERROR","CRITICAL")` with the type check first, plus rejection cases for `""` and `"ERR"`.
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:`epoch_ms="$(date -u -d "${captured_at}" +%s%3N ...)"` / `roundtrip=...` / `if [ "${roundtrip}" != "${captured_at}" ] ... _alert_inbox_reject captured_at` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Fresh timestamps are rejected with `reason=captured_at` (CI run 43255940833: test_valid_record_is_stored_at_the_expected_path, test_consumer_repo_is_allowed). Other tests using the same parse pass, so the failure depends on the value; the likely cause is a lossy fractional-second parse.
  WHY: Valid alerts are rejected at random, and route-mode alerts are lost. Fix: parse seconds from `${captured_at:0:19}Z`, round-trip only the seconds part, and set `epoch_ms=$((secs * 1000 + 10#${captured_at:20:3}))`.
- agents.md:around line 5611 (`<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The generated tree is missing `.github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml`, so `make generate-check` fails.
  WHY: static-checks and the lint aggregate fail and later static checks are skipped. Fix: run `make generate`.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:"Workflows" and "Scripts" sections (0 matches for `alert_inbox|alert-inbox-intake`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: tests/inventory_parity.py requires entries for the new workflow and two scripts.
  WHY: tests-release-and-log-analysis fails with 9 FAIL lines, including README.md:2512/2523 and agents.md:2021, and later steps are skipped.
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:`_alert_inbox_ensure_branch` 200 path `return 0`; PUT loop `404|422` arm `if [ "${BRANCH_CREATED}" -eq 1 ]; then continue; fi` → `_alert_inbox_fail "http_${put_code}"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A branch created concurrently makes the ref GET return 200 without `BRANCH_CREATED=1`, so the run fails instead of retrying the PUT.
  WHY: Per-run concurrency groups let parallel runs drop records. Fix: set `BRANCH_CREATED=1` before `return 0`, or only when `put_code` is 404. This changes `test_unexplained_422_with_existing_branch_fails`.
- .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml:step "Notify store failure" (`if: failure()` ... `source scripts/tg_helpers.sh`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After a failed checkout, `source` of the missing helper aborts and no notice is sent.
  WHY: This contradicts "A failed store sends one Telegram notice". Fix: an `[ -f scripts/tg_helpers.sh ]` guard with an `::error::` line.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "New `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json` with: `capture_enabled: false` and `route_warning_error_to_inbox: false`; `pipeline_self_files` ...; `break_glass_allowed_paths` and `break_glass_denied_paths` ..." | Expected change site: .github/ai/alert_inbox.json (new file, 2-space JSON) | Evidence of absence: Not in pr_changed_files.txt and the glob finds nothing; test_shipped_config_is_off fails with FileNotFoundError. The lists come from docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md lines 310-315, 372-373 and 374-376 | SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
